name: SO Sofitel Mauritius
desc: Experience a luxurious stay at the SO/ Mauritius. desc: Niched along the sheltered west coast of this tropical paradise, Sofitel Mauritius L'Impérial Resort & Spa enchants all who sojourn here. It is a magical place where lush gardens spill onto sugary sand and then the placid sea - a timeless retreat graced by the French Zest and Mauritian vivacity. We invite you to escape and discover.
